snippet.title: Hunter's Seal - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3955230/Hunters_Seal/

Manage the front desk of a fantasy hunters guild. Identify monsters, verify hunters, and authorize them! The guild's reputation is in your hands.

Hunter's Seal is a medieval fantasy job simulator where your observational skills and keen memory will be put to the test. You’re not the hero slaying dragons, you just decide who's foolish enough to try!
